hints.title: Position Grouping
hints.text: Group the indices of each unique value in the array into an ordered occurrence list.

hints.title: Consecutive Triplet Check
hints.text: For any value appearing at least three times, the minimum distance between three elements is achieved by three consecutive appearances indices[p+2] - indices[p].

hints.title: Global Minimum
hints.text: Track the minimum difference across all qualified values; return -1 if no value appears at least three times.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass position grouping and adjacent triplet evaluation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Triple nested loops across all (i, j, k) tuples take cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory to store element index lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Group indices and evaluate adjacent triplets in linear time.
